name: Chinese culture has a long history and is rich in content.
trans: 中国文化历史悠久、内容丰富。

name: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China.
trans: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日。

name: During the Spring Festival, family members get together and celebrate the new year.
trans: 春节期间，家人团聚，庆祝新年。

name: The Dragon Boat Festival is celebrated in memory of the ancient poet Qu Yuan.
trans: 端午节是为了纪念古代诗人屈原。

name: Paper-cutting is a traditional Chinese folk art with a long history.
trans: 剪纸是一门历史悠久的中国传统民间艺术。

name: Peking Opera is regarded as a symbol of traditional Chinese culture.
trans: 京剧被视为中国传统文化的象征。

name: Cultural heritage is valuable and should be well protected.
trans: 文化遗产很有价值，应得到良好保护。

name: The government has taken measures to preserve intangible cultural heritage.
trans: 政府已采取措施保护非物质文化遗产。

name: Young people should inherit and promote traditional Chinese culture.
trans: 年轻人应传承和弘扬中国传统文化。

name: Cultural exchange can promote mutual understanding between different countries.
trans: 文化交流能促进不同国家之间的相互理解。

name: We should respect cultural differences and learn from each other.
trans: 我们应尊重文化差异，互相学习。

name: Traditional culture plays an important role in strengthening cultural identity.
trans: 传统文化在增强文化认同方面发挥重要作用。

name: With the development of globalization, cross-cultural communication is becoming more common.
trans: 随着全球化发展，跨文化交流越来越普遍。

name: Schools can organize activities to raise students’ awareness of cultural heritage protection.
trans: 学校可以组织活动提高学生保护文化遗产的意识。

name: It is our responsibility to keep traditional culture alive.
trans: 让传统文化保持活力是我们的责任。
